device.type: Full HD DVB-T2 / DVB-C terrestrial and cable receiver with Conax / MultiCAS card reader, Ethernet and USB PVR
device.board: 22000A88 (bootloader version "M3821A 1.1.1", 8 MB SPI flash, 128 MB DDR3 M3821 platform)
device.soc: ALi M3821A (128 MB DDR3 dual-CPU DVB-T2/C SoC reading chip ID 0x3821; seecode "M3606 SEE" at 0xA6000200)

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the Amiko firmware archive)
source.author: Amiko
source.note: Archive AMIKO_ECO_TC-200_2.3.15_emu.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-03.

simulator.note: Boots as a 128 MB M3821A board (chips/m3821.py, run_dump_eco_tc200_2315_app_starts.py, run_dump_eco_tc200_2315_capture_screen.py): the XIP "M3821A 1.1.1" bootloader runs through cache-as-RAM, writes " ON " to the CH455 front panel on GPIO 128 / 129, parks the SEE boot stub at 0xA1016804, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xA6000200 and maincode(AV) ("22000A882315", 12.16 MB) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x86002001).  The application updates the CH455 panel to " on " and renders its 1280x720 OSD dialog through GE_M36F.

desc: Amiko Eco TC-200 (System ID 22000A88) firmware v2.3.15 EMU (2017-3-31) on an 8 MB SPI flash for the Full HD DVB-T2/C terrestrial and cable receiver on the ALi M3821A SoC with 128 MB DDR3.
Uses an XIP CacheAsRam bootloader ("M3821A 1.1.1"), dual-CPU "M3606 SEE" firmware at 0xA6000200, and a 4-digit CH455 LED front panel on GPIO 128 (SCL) / 129 (SDA).
